feed.title: SDA Awards $1.6 Billion in Tranche 3 Tracking Layer Contracts to Rocket Lab and Northrop Grumman
feed.summary: The Space Development Agency (SDA) has awarded $1.6 billion in contracts to Rocket Lab and Northrop Grumman for the Tranche 3 Tracking Layer of the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.
